get_me.title: Get the authenticated account
get_me.description: The account this API key belongs to. The cheapest call that proves the key works and says which DailyBot organisation it reaches.

output.description: The requested record.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: The people in the DailyBot organisation, with their ids and chat-platform handles. The uuid here is what the kudos and check-in tools take.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: One user's profile, including the chat platform they are connected through.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Change one user's profile fields. Only the fields you send are changed.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: The teams defined in the organisation. Check-ins and reports are usually scoped to a team rather than to the whole organisation.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_team.title: Get a team
get_team.description: One team's details and membership, for resolving which people a team-scoped check-in or report actually covers.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

list_checkins.title: List check-ins
list_checkins.description: The recurring check-ins configured in the organisation -- DailyBot's standups and surveys, with their questions and schedules.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_checkin.title: Create a check-in
create_checkin.description: Create a recurring check-in with its questions, participants and schedule. Once created it starts messaging the participants on its schedule, so this reaches real people.

attributes.description: The check-in to create -- its name, questions, participants and schedule.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_checkin.title: Get a check-in
get_checkin.description: One check-in's questions, schedule and participants.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

update_checkin.title: Update a check-in
update_checkin.description: Change a check-in's questions, schedule or participants. Only the fields you send are changed; the next run picks up the change.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_checkin.title: Delete a check-in
delete_checkin.description: Delete a check-in. It stops prompting participants immediately, and its historical responses go with it.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_checkin_responses.title: List a check-in's responses
list_checkin_responses.description: What people answered in one check-in, which is the data every standup report is built from.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

date_start.description: Only responses on or after this date.

date_end.description: Only responses on or before this date.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_checkin_response.title: Submit a check-in response
create_checkin_response.description: Answer a check-in on someone's behalf -- for example from a system that already knows what they did, so they are not asked twice.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

attributes.description: The response -- the user it is for and the answers to the check-in's questions.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_checkin_response.title: Update a check-in response
update_checkin_response.description: Correct an already-submitted check-in response, leaving the fields you do not send alone.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

replace_checkin_response.title: Replace a check-in response
replace_checkin_response.description: Replace a check-in response wholesale. Anything omitted is cleared, which is the difference from the PATCH counterpart.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_checkin_response.title: Delete a check-in response
delete_checkin_response.description: Remove a submitted check-in response. The report for that day loses the entry, so team history changes.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_kudos.title: List kudos
list_kudos.description: The kudos given in the organisation, with who sent each one, who received it and why. The raw data behind recognition reports.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

send_kudos.title: Send kudos
send_kudos.description: Give kudos to a teammate. DailyBot posts it into the connected chat platform, so this is visible to other people the moment it succeeds.

attributes.description: The kudos -- the recipient, the category and the message.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_kudos.title: Get one kudos
get_kudos.description: A single kudos with its sender, recipient, category and message.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

update_kudos.title: Update a kudos
update_kudos.description: Change a kudos after the fact -- typically its message or category.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_kudos_categories.title: List kudos categories
list_kudos_categories.description: The categories kudos can be given under, which is what recognition is grouped by in reports.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

update_kudos_categories.title: Update kudos categories
update_kudos_categories.description: Change the organisation's kudos categories. Existing kudos keep the category they were given under.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_forms.title: List forms
list_forms.description: The forms defined in the organisation -- DailyBot's structured request and survey flows, as opposed to recurring check-ins.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_form.title: Get a form
get_form.description: One form's fields and configuration, so a caller knows what a submission must contain.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

list_form_responses.title: List a form's responses
list_form_responses.description: The submissions made to one form, with each respondent's answers.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

date_start.description: Only responses on or after this date.

date_end.description: Only responses on or before this date.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_form_response.title: Submit a form response
create_form_response.description: Submit a response to a form on someone's behalf. Whatever the form is wired to trigger -- a notification, a workflow -- runs as a result.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

attributes.description: The submission -- the user it is for and the answers to the form's fields.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

list_workflows.title: List workflows
list_workflows.description: The workflows configured in the organisation, each with its trigger and the steps it runs.

page.description: Which page of results to return.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

create_workflow.title: Create a workflow
create_workflow.description: Create a workflow with its trigger and steps. It becomes live as soon as it is created, so it can start acting on real events immediately.

attributes.description: The workflow to create -- its trigger, steps and settings.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_workflow.title: Get a workflow
get_workflow.description: One workflow's trigger, steps and current state.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The requested record.

update_workflow.title: Update a workflow
update_workflow.description: Change part of a workflow's trigger or steps, leaving the rest as they are.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

replace_workflow.title: Replace a workflow
replace_workflow.description: Replace a workflow's definition wholesale. Anything omitted is cleared, which is the difference from the PATCH counterpart.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_workflow.title: Delete a workflow
delete_workflow.description: Delete a workflow. It stops running immediately and its configuration cannot be recovered.

uuid.description: The record's uuid, as returned by the corresponding list tool.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.
